name: 31525 · Brunswick, GA
findings: ZIP 31525 (Brunswick) has 73 nonprofit organizations. 29 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (39% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 31525 (Brunswick) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
38% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 31525 (Brunswick) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 64% of the typical level).
